name: DCM Shriram Ltd

ledger.quote: Our target this year is to reach over 80% capacity utilization.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.verdict: Management targeted over 80% capacity utilization and achieved 82% in Q1 FY27.
ledger.evidence: Capacity utilization during the quarter stood at 82%. This will improve further as our downstream projects get commissioned.

ledger.quote: We will be commissioning within this quarter and the capacity ramp up will happen within the next few quarters.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.verdict: Management commissioned the ECH plant, which is currently operating at 70% capacity utilization.
ledger.evidence: Our epichlorohydrin and epoxy plants are currently operating at around 70% capacity utilization each, reflecting continuous ramp-up and stable operations.

ledger.quote: Further, we are confident of operationalizing balance 17,000 tons per annum capacity shortly and ramp-up will happen in the next few quarters.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.verdict: Management operationalized ECH capacity, with plants now operating at 70% capacity utilization.
ledger.evidence: Our epichlorohydrin and epoxy plants are currently operating at around 70% capacity utilization each, reflecting continuous ramp-up and stable operations.

ledger.quote: We do expect that by this year-end, we should turn it around and we should be breaking even by the year-end.
ledger.speaker: Amit Agarwal
ledger.target: break even by year-end for HSCL
ledger.verdict: Target to break even for HSCL by FY26 end was not discussed in the latest call.

ledger.quote: So we see a healthy demand growth in the epoxy, in the advanced materials business.
ledger.speaker: Aditya Shriram
ledger.target: healthy demand growth in epoxy by FY28
ledger.verdict: Target for demand growth in epoxy by FY28 remains in the future.

ledger.quote: So in the coming two quarters, we actually expect our chlorine integration to reach a level of about 45% across both our Bharuch and Kota sites.
ledger.speaker: Aditya Shriram
ledger.verdict: Management stated captive chlorine integration will reach almost 50% with downstream project completions.
ledger.evidence: So, after the current projects are completed of aluminum chloride, calcium chloride, et cetera, we would have almost 50% of our chlorine which will be captively consumed.

ledger.quote: And by the end of this quarter, we expect to commission the remaining capacity.
ledger.speaker: Aditya Shriram
ledger.verdict: Management commissioned the remaining capacity, operating ECH and epoxy plants at 70% capacity utilization.
ledger.evidence: Our epichlorohydrin and epoxy plants are currently operating at around 70% capacity utilization each, reflecting continuous ramp-up and stable operations.

ledger.quote: So in the next year, FY '27 onwards, we should see a good profitability from this vertical.
ledger.speaker: Aditya Shriram
ledger.verdict: Target of profitability from advanced materials in FY27 is ongoing.

ledger.quote: If all goes well, maybe next 3 months, 4 months we should be there.
ledger.speaker: Amit Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Demerger was not completed within 3 to 4 months due to internal structural issues.
ledger.evidence: Having multiple SBUs within the business, there are certain issues which have to be sorted out. So we are working on that very actively, but we are clear we will move ahead with the demerger.

ledger.quote: So, we will continue to target around 14% margin.
ledger.speaker: Amit Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management targeted 14% margin, but OPM fell to 9.0% in June 2026 and 7.0% in September 2026.

ledger.quote: And phase one is slated to be commissioned by the end of next quarter.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.verdict: Commissioning of phase one aluminum extrusion by Q1 FY27 was not mentioned on the call.

ledger.quote: The indicated timeline for completion of the above project will be around Q1 financial year '28.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.topic: Renewable power supply capex for Bharuch plant
ledger.verdict: Timeline for Bharuch RE power project completion in Q1 FY28 remains pending.

ledger.quote: The same is expected to be commissioned by Q2 financial year '28.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Shriram
ledger.target: Commission formulated resins capacity expansion to 50 KTPA
ledger.verdict: Timeline for formulated resins capacity expansion in Q2 FY28 remains pending.

ledger.quote: Yes, we expect to achieve break-even this year.
ledger.speaker: Aditya Shriram
ledger.verdict: Target to achieve break-even during FY27 remains ongoing.

open.quote: commercial production is expected to commence during Q2, further strengthening our downstream chemical portfolio.
open.speaker: Ajay Shriram

open.quote: It should be around the similar levels, not a significant reduction because we do have capex of around INR1,000 crore this year.
open.speaker: Amit Agarwal

open.quote: objective is yes, we make the application to the government in this financial year.
open.speaker: Ajay Shriram

read: Management consistently delivers on chemical capacity commissioning and utilization targets. However, timelines for corporate restructuring like the demerger slipped, and operating profit margins lagged targets.
questions: What is the revised concrete timeline for filing the demerger application following the initial delay?
Why did overall OPM fall to 7% in September 2026 against the 14% target?
What is the status of phase one aluminum extrusion commissioning originally scheduled for Q1 FY27?
bull: Chemicals segment revenue grew 33% YoY in Q1 FY27 with 82% capacity utilization.
Chlorine integration is set to reach 50% as new downstream projects commence commercial operations.
FY26 revenue reached Rs 13,538 crore while financial leverage remained modest at 0.24 Debt/Equity.
bear: Operating profit margin dropped sharply to 7.0% in Sep 2026 from 14.0% in Dec 2025.
Demerger execution has been delayed beyond the promised 3 to 4 month timeframe.
Bioseed PBDIT swung to negative Rs 9 crore in Q1 FY27 due to delayed rainfall.
